Name: The Wardens
Description: A bot faction stranded in a poisoned wasteland; their wellbeing is Data. A story tutorial opens the building bar chapter by chapter, with cutscenes, on a generated wasteland map. Ships with the Timberbot API (HTTP/WebSocket + in-game widget) and an in-game MCP server so an AI agent can play alongside you. Disable the standalone Timberbot API mod when this one is on.
